description: Change a Discord role's name, color, hoist, mentionable or permissions. role is its id or exact name. Changing PERMISSIONS changes what every member holding the role may do, so when anyone holds it call WITHOUT confirm first: nothing changes and you get a sentence with how many members it affects. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

color.description: a hex color like #5865F2, or a whole number

confirm.description: true only once the user agreed to a permissions change

discordServer.description: which Discord server (id or name) when the bot is in several

hoist.description: show its members as their own group in the member list

name.description: the role name, up to 100 characters

permissions.description: what the role may do, as Discord permission names (e.g. ["VIEW_CHANNEL","SEND_MESSAGES"]) or a bitfield string. The bot can only grant permissions it has itself

role.description: the role id or exact name (list_discord_roles)

name: update_discord_role
title: Edit a Discord role
